podcast.body: A song from The Black Keys' eighth studio album, *Turn Blue*, which was released on May 12, 2014. "The Black Keys and Fever from their 8th studio album Turn Blue, which came out on May 12, 2014."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Catching Up With The Black Keys

podcast.body: The song "Fever" is featured on the vinyl edition of The Black Keys' 2014 album Turn Blue, noted for its "lovely 180 gram vinyl" and the effect of its artwork on the 12x12 canvas. "The Black Keys and Fever taken from the vinyl edition of their Turn Blue album, again, lovely 180 gram vinyl."
